item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.text: Turn this pic into a square LinkedIn headshot, quick pls.
turns.agent:
Your Magic Hour account is out of credits, so I couldn’t generate the headshot.

Quick workaround: your photo is already square—crop slightly tighter around your head and shoulders, then replace the park background with light gray for a clean LinkedIn look.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Turn the supplied portrait into a polished, photorealistic square LinkedIn professional headshot. Preserve the woman's exact identity, facial features, natural skin texture, dark curly hair and gentle closed-mouth smile. Head-and-shoulders framing, centered, upright, looking at camera, comfortable space above hair. Replace park background with a clean softly blurred light gray studio background. Soft flattering professional studio lighting, natural colors, crisp eyes. Keep her gray knit top, neatly presented. Subtle natural retouching only. No text, logos or borders.
